votes.motion: Council Member Gerber moved to approve Max Doilney as the Mayor Pro Tem and Tim Henney as the Alternate Mayor Pro Tem
Council Member Worel moved to approve the City Council meeting minutes from motion
Council Member Henney moved to approve Ordinance 2021-01, an ordinance approving the 2021 regular meeting schedule for City Council

Council Member Joyce moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-02, an ordinance approving an extension of City Council’s January 15, 2019 approval of Ordinance No. 2019-03, an ordinance approving the 510 Ontario Avenue Plat Amendment, located at 510 Ontario Avenue, Park City, Utah, and Ordinance No. 2019-04, an ordinance amending Ordinance No. 15-12 and approving the Roundabout Condominiums First Amendment, located at 300 Deer Valley Drive, Park City, Utah

Council Member Henney moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-03, an ordinance approving the King’s Crown Re-Subdivision Second Amended Lot Line Adjustment Plat, amending Lots 27, 28, and 29, located in Park City, Summit County, Utah
Council Member Joyce moved to approve Ordinance 2021-04, an ordinance accepting the public improvements for the Park City Heights, Phase 1 Subdivision and Park City Heights, Phase 2 Subdivision

Council Member Doilney moved to approve Resolution 01-2021, a resolution adopting the American Public Works Association (APWA) Standard Specifications/Plans and the used for the design and construction of projects, including private development, within existing and future public right of way, in a form approved by the City Attorney

Board Member Gerber moved to approve Resolution HA 01-2021, a resolution establishing a regular meeting date, time, and location for 2021 meetings and appointing officers of the Board of Directors of the Housing Authority of Park City, Utah

Board Member Joyce moved to approve Resolution RDA 01-2021, a resolution establishing a regular meeting date, time, and location for 2021 meetings and appointing officers of the Board of Directors of the Redevelopment Agency of Park City, Utah
